annotations.text:
The one screen where the UI is deliberately not dense.

Nine megabytes is a real wait. Naming what is loading, itemised with sizes, turns dead time into an explanation of the product's model — embedded fonts, in-tab rendering, no server.

A spinner with no progress would not be acceptable at this payload size.

Band boundaries are the highest-stakes ambiguity on the canvas.

Which band a component lands in decides whether it repeats on every page — so an unclear boundary produces wrong output, not a cosmetic error.

Hence: dashed rules extending past the page edge, labelled tabs outside it, and a tint on the repeating bands.

Bound components show the BINDING PATH, never a sample value.

The value depends on data supplied at render time. Showing a preview value would set a false expectation about what the recipient sees.

The tree is the only place sample values appear — and it says which file they came from.

Column config is a MATRIX — columns as rows, attributes as columns.

A repeated single-column form hides the comparison that matters: widths against the available page width, and which columns carry aggregates.

The width budget (Σ 174.0 of 174.0 mm) makes fixed-width columns legible as a constraint.

Diagnostics and errors must be distinguishable without colour.

Diagnostic: triangle, dashed border, render completed.
Error: square, solid border, render failed.

The legend sits in the panel so the distinction is learnable, not folklore.

Deliberately absent everywhere: share buttons, collaborator avatars, sync indicators, autosave, account menu.

There is no server and no account. Every one of those would be a lie — and the status bar says so plainly instead.
